claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemComponentMechanics.spawned_creature
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is an activated magic item that creates, commands, and dismisses a companion with explicit initiative, obedience, and disappearance rules. Companion-creation payloads exist only for spells today, so there is no honest magic-item family that can carry this behavior.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action to summon a Fire Elemental.
